## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `ba6792906cef46be53570f5847e1dfb87d5d153e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: whole diff against merge base `4034a6d2f8`: `.changeset/36645-report-builder-filter.md`, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/builder/ReportBuilder.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/builder/reportBuilderModel.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/reportBuilder-36374.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportBuilderHost.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/reportFilterFields.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FilterConditionField.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportBuilderHost.filter-36645.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.saveRefusal-11583.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (11). Cited, read only: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/datasetFilterCondition.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (`conditionCandidatesOf`, `filterConditionFieldsOf`), `ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`, `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-filter-field-binding.ts`, `packages/services/service-analytics/src/read-scope-sql.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/filter-comparand-shape.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts` (`FilterConditionSchema`), `.changeset/config.json`, `AGENTS.md` step 3
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

The head did not move during the review. Everything below comes from reading the diff and the tree. I ran nothing. CI on the head is green: every check-run is success or skipped.

### ① Derived judgments

**The widening is minimal and additive.** `@object-ui/plugin-list` `index.tsx` adds two value exports (`conditionCandidatesOf`, `conditionOptionsOf`) and one type export (`ConditionCandidateField`). All three already existed as exports of the `ListView` module. No body changed. Nothing was removed or renamed. The changeset names exactly these three. `ReportBuilderProps.filter?: React.ReactNode` is a new optional prop, so every existing caller is unaffected. The `label` that became optional on `FilterConditionField` is not on the published surface: app-shell's `exports` maps only `.` and `./styles.css`, and its index does not reach the component. The widening has a reason. The dataset designer's own field list has no option pickers or lookup target. Reusing the list's one mapping avoids writing a second copy.

**Declarations: correct.** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` appear at line start in both the PR body and the changeset. `none` is true: `runtimeFilter` is already a spec key, and no key, value or type moves. Each of the 11 locales gains exactly the four keys the changeset names.

**Round trip of a holdable filter: exact.** `FilterBuilder` emits nothing on read (its read boundary only re-seeds state). `FilterConditionField` commits only from the builder's `onChange`. So opening a report, and opening the popover, never writes the draft. Save passes the draft object as it is. An edit rewrites only spelling: `{stage:'won'}` becomes `{stage:{$eq:'won'}}`, and a single-member `$and` collapses. The meaning is the same.

**Last condition removed drops the key: yes.** An empty group passes `isClearedGroup`, `onCommit(undefined)` runs, and `commitFilter` deletes `runtimeFilter`. An unfinished seeded row commits nothing. The Clear-all path is pinned. The remove-row path takes the same branch.

**Unholdable filter saved byte-identical: yes, for the shapes the bridge recognises.** When `representable` is false, the field shows only a note and has no commit path. The draft keeps the same reference, so Save sends the same bytes. Exception: see M1.

**Does opening ever rewrite? No.** Nothing commits on open. But one valid shape is read wrongly and is lost on the next edit (M1).

**Pins fail without the fix: consistent by reading.** Without the change, these fail:
- the two slot and preview pins in `reportBuilder-36374` (the slot is not drawn);
- four of the five host pins (no 「+ Filter」 and no note);
- the new `opensInBuilder` pin (its `true` cases).

That is 7, the thread's number. Two pins pass on base, and that is right: the pure `reportFilterFields` pin, and the `pickDataset` pin, which only pins existing behaviour (base already deletes `runtimeFilter` on a switch). I read this and did not run it.

**Fields the door won't lower.** Relationship paths are not offered. The door binds a bare object-field key past a shadowing dimension (`bindDatasetFiltersToObjectFields`). So for stored fields, the list matches what the door lowers. Two gaps remain: S1 (virtual fields) and N3 (readability).

### ② Semver level

- All four moved packages are graded `patch`: `plugin-report`, `app-shell`, `plugin-list`, `i18n`.
- `patch` is right. AGENTS.md step 3: a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`. `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`.
- The `@object-ui/*` packages are one `fixed` group in `.changeset/config.json`. So app-shell's `workspace:^` peer on plugin-list always resolves to a version that has the new exports.
- There is no BREAKING banner and no ADR-0087 marker, and none is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`$and` with sibling keys is read as holdable (M1).** `conditionToGroup` (`datasetFilterCondition.ts` line 406) reads only `cond.$and` whenever it is an array. Any other top-level key is ignored. Examples: `{ $and: [{stage:'won'}], amount: {$gt: 5} }` or `{ $and: [...], $not: {...} }`. Both are valid spec shapes, because `FilterConditionSchema` is a record intersected with optional `$and`/`$or`/`$not`. The read says `representable: true`, so `opensInBuilder` now routes such a report to the builder. The trigger reads "1 condition". The first edit to any row commits only the `$and` rows, and Save stores a wider filter. Nothing tells the author. Before this PR, every report with a filter opened the panel, so this path is new for reports.
- **Shape-holdable but field-unholdable (N1).** `opensInBuilder` decides on shape alone. A filter like `{amount:{$in:[1,2]}}` on a number field opens the builder. There it reads unrepresentable and shows "cannot be changed here", and the report no longer reaches the panel that could edit it. It is kept, not rewritten. The PR body says so. The same note also shows while fields load, and stays forever if `getObjectSchema` fails (N2).
- **Error shape, SQL pushdown:** no new id materialisation and no in-app join. The only new read is one `getObjectSchema` per bound object.
- **No test weakened.** One `opensInBuilder` assertion ("a saved filter keeps the panel") is replaced. It encoded the premise this card changes. The cross-tab and several-values assertions stay.
- **Author:** `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no login note.

### ④ Design judgment

The slot design is right. The builder stays field-agnostic, and the host supplies the one shared editor and the one shared field mapping. `pickDataset` already drops the filter on a switch. It is wrong to rely on the shared bridge's shape read without first checking that it covers the whole spec shape. M1 is that gap.

- **M1 (must-fix) — A saved `runtimeFilter` with `$and` beside other top-level keys is silently narrowed on the next edit.** `conditionToGroup` drops the sibling keys of `$and` and still calls the result representable. So `opensInBuilder` routes the report to the builder, the editor shows only the `$and` rows, and the first edit plus Save loses the sibling conditions. The report then shows more rows. This breaks the PR's own claim that an unholdable filter is kept byte-identical. Fix in the shared bridge: when `$and` is present, require it to be the only key, else return `representable: false`. Add two pins: the `opensInBuilder` table (`{ $and:[…], x:… }` and `{ $and:[…], $not:… }` keep the panel) and a bridge round-trip pin. The fix also closes the same hole in the dataset designer.
- **S1 (should-fix) — The builder offers virtual (`formula`) fields, and the dataset door refuses a filter on one.** `reportFilterFields` drops only `hidden`. The engine's admission (`filter-comparand-shape.ts`, reached from the analytics path per `read-scope-sql.ts`) refuses a filter on a field that `isVirtualSearchField` matches, with `400 INVALID_FIELD`. The author sees the preview fail, but can still save a report that then fails for every viewer. Fix: leave out `isVirtualSearchField` fields in `reportFilterFields`, as the list already does for grouping, and add one line to the field-list pin.

Notes:
- N1. A filter that holds by shape but not by field type now opens the builder with a "kept" note and can no longer reach the panel. Consider passing the fields to the routing decision, or having the note say where to edit. Not a data risk.
- N2. While fields load (`fields = []`), a non-text operator reads against the default text bucket and briefly shows the "cannot be changed here" note. If the schema read fails, the note stays. Also, while the catalog has not yet named the object, `loading` reports false, so the popover would say "no fields" rather than "loading".
- N3. Fields are not narrowed by `canReadField`, as the list's `filterConditionFieldsOf` does. The door's field-read admission refuses an unreadable field, and the builder is admin-only. The PR body says this. Not security-touching.
- N4. A stored condition on a hidden field (for example `organization_id`), or on a dotted path, draws a row whose field is not in the dropdown. The list keeps such a held field listed so its row is not blank. The value is kept on save.
- N5. The "unholdable, kept byte-identical" pin uses `toEqual` on a shape that `opensInBuilder` already routes to the panel. A field-unholdable case (for example `$gt` on a text field) would pin the in-builder path more directly.

Implemented-by: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (session `01JQwxbXeiNLk9jGd2XxhBfz`)
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `bdf493b77bb873bddad2f487b8ab7a3e58984eca`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the delta ba679290..bdf493b7 (one commit, 6 files: `.changeset/36645-report-builder-filter.md`, `datasetFilterCondition.ts` and its `.test.ts`, `reportFilterFields.ts`, `ReportBuilderHost.filter-36645.test.tsx`, `ReportView.saveRefusal-11583.test.tsx`) plus, read only: the rest of `conditionToGroup` and `groupToCondition`, `ReportView.tsx` `opensInBuilder`, `FilterConditionField.tsx`, `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts` (`isVirtualSearchField`, `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES`), `packages/spec/package.json` (`./data`), `ui/packages/app-shell/package.json`, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (`conditionCandidatesOf`), the PR body.
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

The PR head is still `bdf493b7`. I ran nothing; everything here comes from reading the code. CI on the head is still running. 9 checks passed and 15 were skipped. 19 are in progress, including Type Check UI, Lint UI and Check Changeset. None has failed.

### Round-1 items

- **M1 (must-fix): closed.** `conditionToGroup` has a new guard just after the `$or` check. If `$and` is present, it must be the only key and must be an array; otherwise the result is `representable: false`. A second new guard rejects a row whose key starts with `$`, so `$not` is caught at top level and inside `$and`.
  - The `$and` + `amount` and `$and` + `$not` shapes now keep the panel. So does a non-array `$and`.
  - A lone `$and` array takes the same path as before.
  - `groupToCondition` writes only three shapes: `undefined`, one row, or a lone `{ $and: parts }`. All three still read back as holdable. The new control pin shows this: a two-row lone `$and` reads `representable: true`, and `groupToCondition` gives it back unchanged (`toEqual`).
  - The bridge pin covers five shapes. The `$and`-with-siblings cases and `{ $not: { $eq } }` would have read as holdable before this fix. The other cases already failed on base through `readBackOperator` and act as controls.
  - The `opensInBuilder` table has three new `false` rows: `$and` + field, `$and` + `$not`, and a lone `$not`.
  - Dataset designer: nothing changes for valid shapes. The only shapes that change are the misread ones above and a field key starting with `$`. No real field name starts with `$`. No existing test asserts a `$`-keyed row.
- **S1 (should-fix): closed.** `reportFilterFields` now skips any field where `isVirtualSearchField` is true. This uses the spec's own predicate, which is true only for `formula`. It is imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`. That subpath is exported, and app-shell already depends on `@objectstack/spec` and imports from it elsewhere. The field-list pin adds a `weighted` formula field and keeps the expected list `['name','stage','amount','account']`. `conditionCandidatesOf` does not drop formula fields itself, so this pin would fail without the fix.

### Declarations, exports, tests

- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` still start their lines in both the changeset and the PR body. Both are still true: this round changes no protocol key and widens nothing new. The changeset adds two bullets that match the change. All four packages are still `patch`.
- **No new export.** No index or `exports` map changed. `reportFilterFields.ts` and `datasetFilterCondition.ts` gained no exported symbol.
- **No test weakened.** The only removed line is the old title of the field-list test; its assertion is unchanged. Every other test change is an addition. A new host pin covers a filter that holds by shape but not by field type: `{ name: { $gt: 'M' } }` on a text field shows the "kept" note and saves the same filter (`toEqual`). That answers round-1 N5.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N6. Round-1 notes N1–N4 are unchanged by this delta. None of them is a data risk.

**VERDICT: PASS**
